holder-quote: “Better. [A Kingdom’s Strength]. A Skill for a [King]. My Level 30 Skill, in fact. I suppose even after my slumber, I’m stronger than I was as a boy. I still see myself as a greater [King], you see. And I’ve leveled.”
Flos howled. His arms tried to channel his strength. Not a fraction, heedless of whether it would hurt him! The fullest extent of it.
effect-quote: He pulled the collar apart. The relic of millennia, forged to capture Drenir, his bonds that had never been broken—shattered.
